name: Numbered Hotbar Slots
summary: Puts a small number on every hotbar slot, so you know at a glance which number key picks it.
logoPrompt: A row of three stone-grey inventory slots with a glowing white number block hovering above the middle slot

cover.tagline: Know your keys at a glance.

description: **Numbered Hotbar Slots writes a tiny number into each slot of your hotbar, so the right key is always under your eyes.**
- Every hotbar slot shows its number from 1 to 9 in the top-left corner.
- Light grey pixel digits with a dark shadow stay readable on the dark slots.
- Swords, pickaxes and most other items leave that corner free, and the item count and durability bar keep their places.
- The number stays visible on the selected slot too.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. Only the hotbar picture changes, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- The numbers match the default keys. If you moved the hotbar keys in your controls, the slots still show 1 to 9.
- Another resource pack that changes the hotbar wins if it sits higher in the list.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or want a different look? Leave a comment.
